objective_slice: Add an inventory-completeness gate and assess current component maturity against the asset-scoped full-path semantic-verification objective.

deterministic_detection_repair_runtime_p.basis: detector, repair suggestions, reachability, symmetry, real bounded verification, paired evidence and regression infrastructure exist

one_asset_declared_scope_complete.basis: NCNN has the strongest before/after and paired runtime materials, but they still need normalization into the new asset contract and independent inventory closure

cross_asset_generality.basis: 34 findings span five component types and registry has 12 cases, but full evidence is concentrated in NCNN; ORT and MindSpore are mostly partial/scoped

embodied_control_semantics.basis: Agibot/AimRT/XR have useful reachability, ASan or L3 evidence, but lack contract adapters, repair pairs, and complete side-effect oracles

maturity_assessment.universal_all_input_provider_configurati: not a finite or appropriate plugin claim

fail_closed_rules: missing inventory is an artifact error and asset.inventory_completeness is missing
declared path IDs must match the paths list
PASS inventory with non-empty unverified items is invalid
inventory evidence remains distinct from path runtime evidence

ort_pr28003.interpretation: The evidence artifacts are hash/case/assertion reproducible, but the declared path and dimension scope is not closed; no semantic uplift is granted.
